arguments.summary: APT-41 (Double Dragon) attributed activity detected on a Finance workstation (WS-FIN-042). Initial access achieved via phishing email triggering malicious PowerShell from Outlook. The payload, a ShadowPad variant, established a C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS. Evidence of host file manipulation and lateral movement attempts (SMB access to file server) were observed. The compromised user account (CORP\jsmith) was used for credential access and lateral movement. Containment actions were successful, including network isolation, credential reset, and host remediation.

arguments.summary: Post-exploitation activity detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. Investigation confirmed execution of a malicious PowerShell payload delivered via Outlook, resulting in the loading of an unsigned DLL (beacon.dll) used for C2 communication with a known Cobalt Strike server (198.51.100.23:443). Hosts file modification was observed, indicating attempts to disrupt security tooling. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to file server 10.0.5.50, and reconnaissance activities (DNS queries to suspicious TLDs) were detected. UEBA analysis indicated low risk due to normal user behavior patterns, suggesting potential account compromise rather than insider threat. The sample hash e9f0a1b2... was previously observed in a benign context, highlighting a gap in threat intelligence correlation.

rule Suspicious_PowerShell_From_Outlook {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell launched with common malicious flags from Outlook process"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0"
    strings:
        $powershell_exe = "powershell.exe" nocase
        $hidden_window = "-w hidden" nocase
        $no_profile = "-nop" nocase
        $encoded_command = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $outlook_parent = "outlook.exe" nocase
    condition:
        all of them and
        \$powershell_exe at 0 and
        \$outlook_parent
}
